CustomField.description: Day of the month on which each installment transaction is created. Restricted picklist: '1'..'28' or 'LastDay'. Values 29-31 rejected with INVALID_OR_NULL_FOR_RESTRICTED_PICKLIST. Used in conjunction with TransactionPeriod and TransactionInterval.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The day of the month payments are scheduled to post. For payments due at the end of the month, choose 'LastDay' — this handles February and other short months automatically. Do not enter 29, 30, or 31.
